summary: SilverBox Corp IV, a SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing an amendment to its business combination agreement with Parataxis Holdings Inc. The First Amendment extends the Outside Date from May 6, 2026 to August 6, 2026, providing additional time to close the de-SPAC transaction. No changes to deal terms, price, or structure were disclosed. The extension is a standard SPAC timeline adjustment, often used to satisfy closing conditions or regulatory approvals. The deal originally had a SPAC structure with Pubco as the combined entity. No break fee or premium details are mentioned. Investors should watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance before the new deadline; any further delays or termination could impact SPAC arbitrage positions.
